text_block_list.text:
One day, as Stay Gold arrived at the dance 
studio for her lesson, there was already 
someone else occupying the room.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mmmmm～～ You're welcome! My dancable Comrade, to share is only natural! Ho-hohohohoho!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufufu ♪ Right now, I just channelled "It's your dance lesson? I shall hand the studio over to you!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: And, I replied with my thanks. Hahaha, it's the power of body language.

Regardless, to see them react to each other 
instantly in the moment was a surprise. Even 
after explaining it to me, I don't think I'm any 
closer to understanding what just happened.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
This is just a difference in experience right? 
When you're travelling around the world, 
you'll encounter all sorts of people you 
can't communicate with.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
When that happens, you've gotta move 
with intention and let your facial 
expression do the talking.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh that's right, for example… Villages in the 
jungle would display friendliness by 
expressing "We're not hostile here～", or…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Dance is a universal language after all ♪ Fufun, I would do the exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
When you're surrounded by some thugs, 
you'd make a threatening pose like "You 
coming at me bro?", or like…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ouhhh……! How thrilling…! And with that you were able to avoid getting into a fight isn't that right!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahahahah, it's not like I'm always out here dancing around though.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It's just that sometimes, your attitude 
can be more powerful than your words.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mmm～ I completely understand! Oh indeed there is something that connects all us horsegirl comrades worldwide!

I see now, the more I listen to this, it's 
actually a pretty interesting concept. 
Though what really piqued my interested 
was…
choice_data_list:
Should we add some of that "friendliness"
to your live shows?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice idea! Let us get onto this 
and try it out right now!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh～ We're doing it?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah, just like that! Haha, I knew it, 
Pearl really has got the moves.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fuuuuu!! This is Friendship! This is Friendship!!
choice_data_list: Somehow, seeing it feels so much fun…!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Right? Oh yeah, you should dance too! Ahahahahah!

An offer I couldn't turn down, I find myself in 
a dance circle! Sharing our fun through just 
our emotions, Stay Gold's expressiveness 
has improved… perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Cool, you say. I see. Might be a good idea 
to incorporate that into our choreo.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I definitely want some of that in my moves. Swat away the bad, and show off my power!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fuu……! Like this!? Hey hey hey! Get outta my sight!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeahhh. If I could recall, it was more like…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I see now… So it's something like this! You seemed to be holding something. Thanks, Stego!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, I'm glad I was able to be of inspiration.

Without realizing it, I was already trembling 
from fear. Once again, I was able to 
experience Stay Gold's wealth of 
knowledge at work…!
